description: Exact Fill.cpp mutations for the body-origin and bounding-box semantics observed by the compact surface-centering matrix. The earlier PrintObject invalidation/body-analysis candidates were observationally equivalent for this fixture and remain documented in their separate report.

mutants.description: Removing the each-model surface gate must alter the center-mode matrix's parsed path sequences.
Skipping per-model body selection must alter each-model centered top/bottom paths.
Replacing octagram-spiral eligibility with rectilinear disables per-body centering for one of the tested surface patterns.
Discarding the selected body bounding box must change the compact surface path sequences.
